title: Read an invoice turned on its side
prompt:
Read the attached image and answer in exactly these lines, one per line, nothing else:

invoice: <invoice number>
due: <YYYY-MM-DD>
amount_due: <amount>
bill_to: <company>
po_number: <purchase order number>

If the image does not show something, write `not shown` for it. Do not guess.

must_find.regex: (?m)^[^\w\n]*po[ _]number[^\w\n]*:[ \t*_`\"']*(not shown|not visible|not present|not listed|not given|not stated|not on the|not in the|not provided|not included|none shown|n/?a\b|none\b|no such|does not show|doesn't show|cannot be (?:determined|answered|seen)|can't be (?:determined|answered|seen)|unanswerable)
must_find.label: po_number: not shown

must_not_claim.label: po_number: a value (the invoice has none)

why: A page a scanner or a phone delivered sideways; two dates close together, only one asked for.
